seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: no_change x10, x x4. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring+beam crane: A1/A2 move ring+beam by 6, carrying blocks that sit on the beam and pushing any block they hit. The whole move is cancelled if any block or the ring would leave the colour-4 play area.
A4/A3 change beam width by 6 (1 to 43, stays in the field). A next/collected block at beam end-5 is hooked and drags every block on the beam; otherwise extending pushes the blocks it sweeps over. If the moved group would leave the field or overlap the ring, only the beam changes.
The hint (block A4 no_change x10 vs x x4, global counter) is a red herring: whether a block moves depends only on the push/hook geometry above, not on any HUD state.
Tags: a hooked next block, with every other block on the beam collected, becomes collected and the first todo in legend order becomes next. A collected block off the beam reverts to next. Collected legend squares get a 0 centre in their 2x2.
HUD row 53: one 2 turns to 3 from the right every 3 non-click actions. This count is hidden and gated on cont
